oracle_layers.jcs: independent ECMAScript JSON serialization oracle with normative fixed vectors
oracle_layers.report_invariants: protocol-governed logical invariants evaluated independently of product code
oracle_layers.schema: jsonschema Draft 2020-12 oracle with positive and negative fixtures

principles: normative expected outcomes may not be generated solely by an implementation under test
schema validity is determined by the canonical Draft 2020-12 schemas through an independent validator
consumer adapters are observational and non-normative
cross-implementation agreement is necessary but never sufficient
known disagreements are blocking and must be enumerated exactly until corrected
removal of a known disagreement requires an approved corpus update and zero-regression evidence
